full_prompt_en: The image is an aged black-and-white cinematic tableau of a woman and formally dressed companions moving down steps in a shadowed passage. The background is nearly black, with faint grey texture and indistinct shapes behind the figures. She occupies the centre foreground, wearing a dark fitted bodice with a pale lace-edged neckline and shoulder trim. Her arms are lifted slightly at either side, elbows bent and hands open, while her face turns toward the viewer. Around and behind her, men in dark suits, high collars and tall or rounded hats lean forward, their bent knees and raised feet suggesting hurried movement. Their positions form a loose semicircle: one figure is cropped at the far left, two stand close behind her, and another larger man occupies the right side. Their pale faces and moustaches contrast with dark clothing, though several features soften into shadow. Broad stone steps rise behind the group, giving the arrangement shallow theatrical depth. The woman’s pale trim, arms and face catch the brightest light, while the hats, jackets and lower bodies merge into broad charcoal masses. Frontal theatrical lighting brightens the central planes and adds a few sharp highlights along collars, leaving the surrounding forms in deep shadow. The image has a grainy, old-film quality, with softened edges, visible tonal noise and slight blur around moving hands. No readable lettering or clear setting details appear. The composition keeps the woman central and low, framed by vertical silhouettes and the dark upper field. Its restrained grey range and staged arrangement create a mysterious, slightly uncanny mood.
full_prompt_zh: 画面是一幅老黑白电影式场景：一名女子与穿正式服装的同伴沿幽暗通道的台阶向下运动。背景近乎纯黑，只在人物后方隐约留有灰色肌理和难以辨认的形状。她位于前景中央，穿深色合身衣身，领口与肩部带浅色蕾丝边饰。双臂略向两侧抬起，肘部弯曲、手掌张开，面部朝向观者。她周围及身后，穿深色西装、立领及高帽或圆帽的男子身体前倾，弯曲膝盖和抬起的脚提示匆忙动作。人物大致围成半圆：最左侧一人被画框截断，两人靠近她身后站立，另有一名较高大的男子占据右侧。他们的浅色面孔和小胡子在深色衣装前显出，部分五官则柔化入阴影。宽阔石阶在众人身后向上延展，构成浅浅的戏剧纵深。女子的浅色边饰、手臂与面部最亮，帽子、外套和下半身则融入宽阔炭灰色块。正面戏剧光照亮中央色面，并在领口留下少量锐利高光，周围形体沉入深影。画面带有颗粒感和旧电影质地，边缘柔化，明度中可见细微噪点，运动的手部周围略带模糊。没有可读文字或清楚场景细节。整体构图将女子置于中央偏下，由周围竖直剪影和上方暗场围合。克制灰阶与舞台式排列共同营造神秘而略显诡异的气氛。
style_prompt_en: Aged monochrome cinematographic treatment combines formal arrangement, grainy tonal texture and selective frontal light. Pale areas emerge against broad dark masses, while mid-grey transitions soften secondary contours. Vertical forms and staggered horizontal planes create a measured rhythm within shallow depth. Soft focus, slight motion blur and uneven grain lend an aged image surface, yet the central contrast remains clear. Light concentrates on a few central planes and small accents, leaving surrounding areas subdued. The overall visual effect is theatrical and enigmatic, balancing orderly placement with shadowed ambiguity.
style_prompt_zh: 老黑白电影式处理结合正式布局、颗粒调性肌理与选择性正面光。浅色区域从宽阔暗块中清楚浮现，中灰过渡则柔化次要轮廓。竖向形体与错落水平面在浅纵深中建立节制节奏。柔焦、轻微动态模糊和不均颗粒形成旧影像表面，但中央反差仍然清楚。光线集中在少数中央色面与细小亮点上，周围区域保持含蓄。整体视觉效果富戏剧性且神秘，在有序布局与阴影含混感之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A woman and formally dressed companions move down stone steps in a grainy monochrome theatrical scene.
theme_zh: 女子与身穿正式服装的同伴沿石阶向下运动，构成带颗粒感的黑白戏剧场景。
name: Georges Melies
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
